Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring submission of digital copies of public employees' collective bargaining agreements.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to digital copies of public employees' collectivebargaining agreements; adding a new section to chapter 41.56 RCW;adding a new section to chapter 41.80 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 41.76 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 41.59 RCW; adding anew section to chapter 49.39 RCW; adding a new section to chapter28B.52 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 47.64 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 49.66 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 41.58RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.56 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Bargaining representatives representing public employees under thischapter shall submit a digital copy of their collective bargainingagreement to the commission within thirty days of the effective date ofthe collective bargaining agreement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.80 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Employee organizations representing public employees under this p. 1 SB 6250chapter shall submit a digital copy of their collective bargainingagreement to the commission within thirty days of the effective date ofthe collective bargaining agreement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.76 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Employee organizations representing faculty public employees underthis chapter shall submit a digital copy of their collective bargainingagreement to the commission within thirty days of the effective date ofthe collective bargaining agreement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.59 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Employee organizations representing educational public employeesunder this chapter shall submit a digital copy of their collectivebargaining agreement to the commission within thirty days of theeffective date of the collective bargaining agreement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.39 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Labor unions representing symphony musicians under this chaptershall submit a digital copy of their collective bargaining agreement tothe commission within thirty days of the effective date of thecollective bargaining agreement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Employee organizations representing academic employees under thischapter shall submit a digital copy of their collective bargainingagreement to the commission within thirty days of the effective date ofthe collective bargaining agreement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.64 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Ferry employee organizations representing ferry employees underthis chapter shall submit a digital copy of their collective bargainingagreement to the commission within thirty days of the effective date ofthe collective bargaining agreement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.66 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Employee organizations representing employees under this chaptershall submit a digital copy of their collective bargaining agreement tothe department within thirty days of the effective date of thecollective bargaining agreement. The department shall maintain a website that allows the public to view and download the collectivebargaining agreements submitted by labor unions pursuant to thissection. The collective bargaining agreements shall be available in auniform digital format. Expired collective bargaining agreements shallbe available on the web site for up to ten years following expiration.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.58 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The commission shall maintain a web site that allows the public toview and download the collective bargaining agreements submitted bylabor unions pursuant to this act. The collective bargainingagreements shall be available in a uniform digital format. Expiredcollective bargaining agreements shall be available on the web site forup to ten years following expiration.
